content: AgroGuardian: src/components/ui/ModalShell.jsx focus/scroll effect has deps [open, onClose] — passing an inline arrow onClose makes focus jump to the close button on every re-render/keystroke. Always pass a stable handler (direct prop ref or useCallback). Escape is handled in capture phase with stopPropagation, so nested child modals (e.g. CompleteActivityModal z-[130] which has no Escape handler) can't get Escape while a ModalShell is open. ModalShell body padding p-4/sm:p-6/md:p-8 merges via cn/tailwind-merge; footer provides flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row.
